purpose: Measure complete research diagnostics from existing rolling historical out-of-sample predictions without reading any FRESH, SCREENING, or FINAL payload. This shortens the research iteration loop; it is not a production-promotion protocol.

target.definition: H4 raw return minus same-origin cross-sectional market median; DOWN < -1%, NEUTRAL inclusive between -1% and +1%, UP > +1%

permitted_data.prediction_inputs: already sealed development prediction files only

interpretation.research_use: A candidate may be diagnosed, compared, rejected, or iterated from these metrics immediately. A failed candidate does not consume a new FRESH window.
interpretation.promotion_use: Forbidden. Historical metrics quantify evidence but do not prove live generalization or authorize production replacement.
interpretation.fresh_policy: A new clean future window is required only once for the final frozen candidate that is proposed for promotion; it is never used as a routine experiment loop.
